# A standard Windows Deployment Script are Expect to run ~5min, plus waiting for SSM to be setup in EC2 instance ~2min
# 15 Min loose upper timeout bound is designed to allow for a rate situation: in a very small chance,

          check_instance_ready() {
            local instance_id=$1
            local max_attempts=30
            local attempt=0

            while [[ $attempt -lt $max_attempts ]]; do
              local state
              state=$(aws ssm describe-instance-information --filters Key=InstanceIds,Values=$instance_id --query "InstanceInformationList[0].PingStatus" --output text) || state="Unknown"
              echo "Attempt $((attempt + 1))/$max_attempts: Current SSM state of instance $instance_id: $state"

              if [[ "$state" == "Online" ]]; then
                echo "Instance $instance_id is 'Online' in Systems Manager and ready."
                return 0
              fi
              echo "Waiting for instance $instance_id to be 'Online' in Systems Manager..."
              sleep $interval
              attempt=$((attempt + 1))
            done

            echo "Timeout reached: Instance $instance_id did not become 'Online' in Systems Manager within expected time."
            exit 1
          }

          send_command_and_wait() {
            local instance_id=$1
            local document_name=$2
            local label=$3
            local max_attempts=60
            local attempt=0
            local command_id=""

            # send-command can fail transiently, so retry until a CommandId is returned
            while [[ $attempt -lt 5 ]]; do
              command_id=$(aws ssm send-command \
                --instance-ids "$instance_id" \
                --document-name "$document_name" \
                --query "Command.CommandId" \
                --output text) && break
              echo "Attempt $((attempt + 1))/5: send-command to instance $instance_id with document $document_name failed, retrying..."
              sleep $interval
              attempt=$((attempt + 1))
            done

            if [[ -z "$command_id" ]]; then
              echo "Failed to send SSM command to instance $instance_id after 5 attempts."
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "$label: Started SSM command $command_id on instance $instance_id using document $document_name"

            # Allow up to 10 min for the SSM command to complete
            attempt=0
            while [[ $attempt -lt $max_attempts ]]; do
              local status
              status=$(aws ssm get-command-invocation \
                --command-id "$command_id" \
                --instance-id "$instance_id" \
                --query "Status" \
                --output text) || status=""

              if [[ -z "$status" ]]; then
                echo "Attempt $((attempt + 1))/$max_attempts: Invocation for command $command_id not available yet, waiting..."
                sleep $interval
                attempt=$((attempt + 1))
                continue
              fi

              echo "Attempt $((attempt + 1))/$max_attempts: Current status of SSM command $command_id: $status"
              if [[ "$status" == "Success" ]]; then
                echo "$label: SSM command $command_id succeeded."
                return 0
              elif [[ "$status" == "Failed" || "$status" == "TimedOut" || "$status" == "Cancelled" ]]; then
                echo "$label: SSM command $command_id failed with status $status."
                exit 1
              fi
              echo "Waiting for SSM command $command_id to complete..."
              sleep $interval
              attempt=$((attempt + 1))
            done

            echo "Max attempts reached: SSM command $command_id for $label did not succeed after $max_attempts attempts."
            exit 1
          }

          check_instance_ready ${{ env.MAIN_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID }}
          check_instance_ready ${{ env.REMOTE_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID }}

1: # The EC2 AMI for K8s needs to be updated to prevent it from becoming outdated. This workflow will run in the beginning of every month to replace the existing
2: # instances with new ones
3: name: K8s Patch OS Job
4: 
5: on:
6:   workflow_call:
7:     inputs:
8:       repo_name:
9:         required: true
10:         type: string
11:       ec2_name:
12:         required: true
13:         type: string
14:       language:
15:         required: true
16:         type: string
17: 
18: permissions:
19:   id-token: write
20:   contents: read
21: 
22: env:
23:   REPO: ${{ inputs.repo_name }}
24:   EC2_NAME: ${{ inputs.ec2_name }}
25:   LANGUAGE:  ${{ inputs.language }}
26:   E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION: us-east-1
27:   E2E_TEST_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLICATION_SIGNALS_E2E_TEST_ACCOUNT_ID }}
28:   E2E_TEST_ROLE_NAME: ${{ secrets.APPLICATION_SIGNALS_E2E_TEST_ROLE_NAME }}
29: 
30: jobs:
31:   create-k8s-on-ec2:
32:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
33:     steps:
34:       - name: Generate Testing ID
35:         run: |
36:           echo TESTING_ID="${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_number }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
37: 
38:       - name: Checkout repository
39:         uses: actions/checkout@v4
40: 
41:       - name: Configure AWS Credentials
42:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
43:         with:
44:           role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::${{ env.E2E_TEST_ACCOUNT_ID }}:role/${{ env.E2E_TEST_ROLE_NAME }}
45:           aws-region: us-east-1
46: 
47:       - name: Create New K8s on EC2
48:         working-directory: .github/workflows/util
49:         run: |
50:           ./setup-k8s.sh ${{ env.TESTING_ID }} ${{ env.EC2_NAME }}-${{ env.LANGUAGE }} ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}
51: 
52:       - name: Check if Secret Key Already Exist and If Not Create New Ones
53:         run: |
54:           SECRET_NAMES=(
55:             "e2e-test/${{ env.REPO }}/${{ env.LANGUAGE }}-k8s-master-node-endpoint-pending-value"
56:             "e2e-test/${{ env.REPO }}/${{ env.LANGUAGE }}-k8s-ssh-key-pending-value"
57:             "e2e-test/${{ env.REPO }}/${{ env.LANGUAGE }}-k8s-master-node-endpoint"
58:             "e2e-test/${{ env.REPO }}/${{ env.LANGUAGE }}-k8s-ssh-key"
59:             "e2e-test/${{ env.REPO }}/${{ env.LANGUAGE }}-k8s-master-node-endpoint-temporary-storage"
60:             "e2e-test/${{ env.REPO }}/${{ env.LANGUAGE }}-k8s-ssh-key-temporary-storage"
61:           )
62: 
63:           for SECRET_NAME in "${SECRET_NAMES[@]}"; do
64:             echo "Checking secret: $SECRET_NAME"
65: 
66: 
67:             if aws secretsmanager describe-secret --secret-id $SECRET_NAME; then
68:               echo "Secret $SECRET_NAME already exists."
69:             else
70:               echo "Secret $SECRET_NAME does not exist. Creating it now"
71:               aws secretsmanager create-secret --name $SECRET_NAME --secret-string "empty"
72:             fi
73:           done
74: 
75: 
76:       - name: Save Private Key and Master Public Endpoint to Secret Manager
77:         working-directory: .github/workflows/util
78:         run: |
79:           SECRET_NAMES=(
80:             "e2e-test/${{ env.REPO }}/${{ env.LANGUAGE }}-k8s-master-node-endpoint-pending-value"
81:             "e2e-test/${{ env.REPO }}/${{ env.LANGUAGE }}-k8s-ssh-key-pending-value"
82:           )
83: 
84:           private_key_file=k8s-on-ec2-${{ env.EC2_NAME }}-${{ env.LANGUAGE }}-key-pair-${{ env.TESTING_ID }}.pem
85:           private_key_content=$(<"$private_key_file")
86: 
87:           master_public_ip=$(aws ec2 describe-instances \
88:             --filters "Name=tag:Name,Values=k8s-on-ec2-${{ env.EC2_NAME }}-${{ env.LANGUAGE }}-master-${{ env.TESTING_ID }}" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" \
89:             --query "Reservations[*].Instances[*].PublicIpAddress" \
90:             --output text)
91: 
92:           aws secretsmanager update-secret --secret-id "${SECRET_NAMES[0]}" --secret-string "$master_public_ip"
93:           aws secretsmanager update-secret --secret-id "${SECRET_NAMES[1]}" --secret-string "$private_key_content"
94:

109:     secrets: inherit

#!/bin/bash
set -ex 

TESTING_ID=$1
EC2_NAME=$2
REGION=$3

INSTANCE_PROFILE="APP_SIGNALS_EC2_TEST_ROLE"
MASTER_INSTANCE_NAME="k8s-on-ec2-${EC2_NAME}-master-${TESTING_ID}"
WORKER_INSTANCE_NAME="k8s-on-ec2-${EC2_NAME}-worker-${TESTING_ID}"
KEY_NAME="k8s-on-ec2-${EC2_NAME}-key-pair-${TESTING_ID}"

function create_resources() {
    echo "Creating Key Pair"
    aws ec2 create-key-pair --key-name "${KEY_NAME}" --query 'KeyMaterial' --output text > "${KEY_NAME}.pem"
    chmod 400  "${KEY_NAME}.pem"

    # Fetch the latest Amazon Linux 2 AMI ID
    echo "Fetching Latest Image Id"
    image_id=$(aws ec2 describe-images \
      --region $REGION \
      --owners amazon \
      --filters "Name=name,Values=al2023-ami-minimal-*-x86_64" "Name=state,Values=available" \
      --query 'Images | sort_by(@, &CreationDate) | [-1].ImageId' \
      --output text)

    default_vpc_id=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --filters Name=isDefault,Values=true --query 'Vpcs[0].VpcId' --output text)
    security_group_id=$(aws ec2 describe-security-groups --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=$default_vpc_id" "Name=group-name,Values=default" --query "SecurityGroups[0].GroupId" --output text)

    # Create Master EC2 Instance
    echo "Creating Master Instance"
    master_instance_id=$(aws ec2 run-instances \
      --image-id $image_id \
      --count 1 \
      --instance-type m5.xlarge \
      --key-name $KEY_NAME \
      --security-group-ids $security_group_id \
      --iam-instance-profile Name=$INSTANCE_PROFILE \
      --associate-public-ip-address \
      --block-device-mappings 'DeviceName=/dev/xvda,Ebs={VolumeSize=80,VolumeType=gp3}' \
      --metadata-options 'HttpPutResponseHopLimit=3,HttpEndpoint=enabled' \
      --query 'Instances[0].InstanceId' \
      --output text)

    aws ec2 create-tags --resources $master_instance_id --tags Key=Name,Value=$MASTER_INSTANCE_NAME Key=k8s-on-ec2-node,Value=true

    echo "Creating Worker Instance"
    worker_instance_id=$(aws ec2 run-instances \
      --image-id $image_id \
      --count 1 \
      --instance-type m5.xlarge \
      --key-name $KEY_NAME \
      --security-group-ids $security_group_id \
      --iam-instance-profile Name=$INSTANCE_PROFILE \
      --associate-public-ip-address \
      --block-device-mappings 'DeviceName=/dev/xvda,Ebs={VolumeSize=80,VolumeType=gp3}' \
      --metadata-options 'HttpPutResponseHopLimit=3,HttpEndpoint=enabled' \
      --query 'Instances[0].InstanceId' \
      --output text)

12: run `docker-compose build` to generate two docker images: `dotnetsampleapp/frontend-service` and `dotnetsampleapp/remote-service`
13: 
14: ### Steps to update image:
15: 1. Login to the testing account
16: 2. Create a new ECR repository if there's no existing one.
17: 3. Login to ECR Repository: `aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin {REPOSITORY}`.
18: 4. tag images and push to repository:
19: ```
20: docker tag dotnetsampleapp/frontend-service:latest ${REPOSITORY_PREFIX}/dotnetsampleapp/frontend-service:latest
21: docker push ${REPOSITORY_PREFIX}/dotnetsampleapp/frontend-service:latest
22: docker tag dotnetsampleapp/remote-service:latest ${REPOSITORY_PREFIX}/dotnetsampleapp/remote-service:latest
23: docker push ${REPOSITORY_PREFIX}/dotnetsampleapp/remote-service:latest
24: ```
25: 
26: 
27: ## EC2 Use Case: Building the ZIP File:
28: 1. Compress the folder with: `zip -r dotnet-sample-app.zip .`
29: 2. Login to the testing account
30: 3. Create a new S3 bucket if there's no existing one.
31: 4. upload `dotnet-sample-app.zip` to the bucket
32: 
33: 
34: ## APIs
35: The following are the APIs supported:
36: 1. http://${ FRONTEND_SERVICE_IP }:8080/outgoing-http-call/
37: 2. http://${ FRONTEND_SERVICE_IP }:8080/aws-sdk-call?testingId=${ TESTING_ID }/
38: 3. http://${ FRONTEND_SERVICE_IP }:8080/remote-service?ip=${ REMOTE_SERVICE_IP }/
39: 4. http://${ FRONTEND_SERVICE_IP }:8080/client-call/

<content>
1: ## Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. All Rights Reserved.
2: ## SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3: 
4: # This is a reusable workflow for running the Enablement test for Application Signals.
5: # It is meant to be called from another workflow.
6: # Read more about reusable workflows: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/reusing-workflows#overview
7: name: DotNet EKS Use Case
8: on:
9:   workflow_call:
10:     inputs:
11:       aws-region:
12:         required: true
13:         type: string
14:       test-cluster-name:
15:         required: true
16:         type: string
17:       adot-image-name:
18:         required: false
19:         type: string
20:       cw-agent-operator-tag:
21:         required: false
22:         type: string
23:       caller-workflow-name:
24:         required: true
25:         type: string
26:     outputs:
27:       job-started:
28:         value: ${{ jobs.dotnet-eks.outputs.job-started }}
29:       validation-result:
30:         value: ${{ jobs.dotnet-eks.outputs.validation-result }}
31: 
32: permissions:
33:   id-token: write
34:   contents: read
35: 
36: env:
37:   E2E_TEST_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLICATION_SIGNALS_E2E_TEST_ACCOUNT_ID }}
38:   E2E_TEST_ROLE_NAME: ${{ secrets.APPLICATION_SIGNALS_E2E_TEST_ROLE_NAME }}
39:   E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION: ${{ inputs.aws-region }}
40:   CLUSTER_NAME: ${{ inputs.test-cluster-name }}
41:   METRIC_NAMESPACE: ApplicationSignals
42:   LOG_GROUP_NAME: /aws/application-signals/data
43:   TEST_RESOURCES_FOLDER: ${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}
44:   ADOT_IMAGE_NAME: ${{ inputs.adot-image-name }}
45:   CW_AGENT_OPERATOR_TAG: ${{ inputs.cw-agent-operator-tag }}
46: 
47: jobs:
48:   dotnet-eks:
49:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
50:     timeout-minutes: 30
51:     outputs:
52:       job-started: ${{ steps.job-started.outputs.job-started }}
53:       validation-result: ${{ steps.validation-result.outputs.validation-result }}
54:     steps:
55:       - name: Check if the job started
56:         id: job-started
57:         run: echo "job-started=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
58: 
59:       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
60:         with:
61:           repository: 'aws-observability/aws-application-signals-test-framework'
62:           ref: ${{ inputs.caller-workflow-name == 'main-build' && 'main' || github.ref }}
63:           fetch-depth: 0
64: 
65:       - name: Initiate Gradlew Daemon
66:         id: initiate-gradlew
67:         uses: ./.github/workflows/actions/execute_and_retry
68:         continue-on-error: true
69:         with:
70:           command: "./gradlew"
71:           cleanup: "./gradlew clean"
72:           max_retry: 3
73:           sleep_time: 60
74: 
75:       - name: Download enablement script
76:         uses: ./.github/workflows/actions/execute_and_retry
77:         with:
78:           pre-command: "mkdir enablement-script && cd enablement-script"
79:           command: "wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws-observability/application-signals-demo/main/scripts/eks/appsignals/enable-app-signals.sh 
80:           && wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws-observability/application-signals-demo/main/scripts/eks/appsignals/clean-app-signals.sh"
81:           cleanup: "rm -f enable-app-signals.sh && rm -f clean-app-signals.sh"
82:           post-command: "chmod +x enable-app-signals.sh && chmod +x clean-app-signals.sh"
83: 
84:       - name: Remove log group deletion command
85:         if: always()
86:         working-directory: enablement-script
87:         run: |
88:           delete_log_group="aws logs delete-log-group --log-group-name '${{ env.LOG_GROUP_NAME }}' --region \$REGION"
89:           sed -i "s#$delete_log_group##g" clean-app-signals.sh
90: 
91:       - name: Generate testing id and dotnet sample app namespace
92:         run: |
93:           echo TESTING_ID="${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_number }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
94:           echo DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE="ns-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_number }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
95: 
96:       - name: Configure AWS Credentials
97:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
98:         with:
99:           role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::${{ env.E2E_TEST_ACCOUNT_ID }}:role/${{ env.E2E_TEST_ROLE_NAME }}
100:           aws-region: us-east-1
101: 
102:       - name: Retrieve account
103:         uses: aws-actions/aws-secretsmanager-get-secrets@v1
104:         with:
105:           secret-ids: |
106:             ACCOUNT_ID, region-account/${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}
107:             DOTNET_MAIN_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE, e2e-test/dotnet-main-sample-app-image
108:             DOTNET_REMOTE_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE, e2e-test/dotnet-remote-sample-app-image
109: 
110:       # ADOT_E2E_TEST_ROLE_ARN is used to access main build e2e test cluster
111:       # E2E_TEST_ROLE_ARN is used to access canary e2e test cluster
112:       - name: Configure AWS Credentials
113:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
114:         with:
115:           role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::${{ env.ACCOUNT_ID }}:role/${{ env.E2E_TEST_ROLE_NAME }}
116:           aws-region: ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}
117: 
118:       # local directory to store the kubernetes config
119:       - name: Create kubeconfig directory
120:         run: mkdir -p ${{ github.workspace }}/.kube
121: 
122:       - name: Set KUBECONFIG environment variable
123:         run: echo KUBECONFIG="${{ github.workspace }}/.kube/config" >> $GITHUB_ENV
124: 
125:       - name: Set up kubeconfig
126:         run: aws eks update-kubeconfig --name ${{ env.CLUSTER_NAME }} --region ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}
127: 
128:       - name: Download and install eksctl
129:         uses: ./.github/workflows/actions/execute_and_retry
130:         with:
131:           pre-command: 'mkdir ${{ github.workspace }}/eksctl'
132:           command: 'curl -sLO "https://github.com/weaveworks/eksctl/releases/latest/download/eksctl_Linux_amd64.tar.gz" 
133:             && tar -xzf eksctl_Linux_amd64.tar.gz -C ${{ github.workspace }}/eksctl && rm eksctl_Linux_amd64.tar.gz'
134:           cleanup: 'rm -f eksctl_Linux_amd64.tar.gz'
135: 
136:       - name: Add eksctl to Github Path
137:         run: |
138:           echo "${{ github.workspace }}/eksctl" >> $GITHUB_PATH
139: 
140:       # This step deletes lingering resources from previous test runs
141:       - name: Delete all sample app namespaces
142:         continue-on-error: true
143:         timeout-minutes: 5
144:         run: kubectl get namespace | awk '/^ns-[0-9]+-[0-9]+/{print $1}' | xargs -r kubectl delete namespace
145: 
146:       - name: Create role for AWS access from the sample app
147:         id: create_service_account
148:         uses: ./.github/workflows/actions/execute_and_retry
149:         with:
150:           command: "eksctl create iamserviceaccount \
151:           --name service-account-${{ env.TESTING_ID }} \
152:           --namespace ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }} \
153:           --cluster ${{ inputs.test-cluster-name }} \
154:           --role-name eks-s3-access-${{ env.TESTING_ID }} \
155:           --attach-policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess \
156:           --region ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }} \
157:           --approve"
158:           cleanup: "eksctl delete iamserviceaccount \
159:           --name service-account-${{ env.TESTING_ID }} \
160:           --namespace ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }} \
161:           --cluster ${{ inputs.test-cluster-name }} \
162:           --region ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}"
163:           sleep_time: 60
164: 
165:       - name: Set up terraform
166:         uses: ./.github/workflows/actions/execute_and_retry
167:         with:
168:           command: "wget -O- https://apt.releases.hashicorp.com/gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/hashicorp-archive-keyring.gpg"
169:           post-command: 'echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/hashicorp-archive-keyring.gpg] https://apt.releases.hashicorp.com $(lsb_release -cs) main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/hashicorp.list
170:               && sudo apt update && sudo apt install terraform'
171:           sleep_time: 60
172: 
173:       - name: Initiate Terraform
174:         uses: ./.github/workflows/actions/execute_and_retry
175:         with:
176:           command: "cd ${{ env.TEST_RESOURCES_FOLDER }}/terraform/dotnet/eks/linux && terraform init && terraform validate"
177:           cleanup: "rm -rf .terraform && rm -rf .terraform.lock.hcl"
178:           max_retry: 6
179:           sleep_time: 60
180: 
181:       - name: Set Sample App Image
182:         run: |
183:           echo MAIN_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE_ARN="${{ env.ACCOUNT_ID }}.dkr.ecr.${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}.amazonaws.com/${{ env.DOTNET_MAIN_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
184:           echo REMOTE_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE_ARN="${{ env.ACCOUNT_ID }}.dkr.ecr.${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}.amazonaws.com/${{ env.DOTNET_REMOTE_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
185: 
186:       - name: Deploy sample app via terraform and wait for the endpoint to come online
187:         id: deploy-dotnet-app
188:         working-directory: ./terraform/dotnet/eks/linux
189:         run: |
190:           # Attempt to deploy the sample app on an EKS instance and wait for its endpoint to come online. 
191:           # There may be occasional failures due to transitivity issues, so try up to 2 times. 
192:           # deployment_failed of 0 indicates that both the terraform deployment and the endpoint are running, while 1 indicates
193:           # that it failed at some point
194:           retry_counter=0
195:           max_retry=2
196:           while [ $retry_counter -lt $max_retry ]; do
197:             echo "Attempt $retry_counter"
198:             deployment_failed=0
199:             terraform apply -auto-approve \
200:               -var="test_id=${{ env.TESTING_ID }}" \
201:               -var="aws_region=${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}" \
202:               -var="kube_directory_path=${{ github.workspace }}/.kube" \
203:               -var="eks_cluster_name=${{ env.CLUSTER_NAME }}" \
204:               -var="eks_cluster_context_name=$(kubectl config current-context)" \
205:               -var="test_namespace=${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }}" \
206:               -var="service_account_aws_access=service-account-${{ env.TESTING_ID }}" \
207:               -var="dotnet_app_image=${{ env.MAIN_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE_ARN }}" \
208:               -var="dotnet_remote_app_image=${{ env.REMOTE_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE_ARN }}" \
209:               -var='account_id=${{ env.ACCOUNT_ID }}' \
210:             || deployment_failed=$?          
211: 
212:             if [ $deployment_failed -ne 0 ]; then
213:               echo "Terraform deployment was unsuccessful. Will attempt to retry deployment."
214:             fi
215: 
216:             # If the deployment_failed is still 0, then the terraform deployment succeeded and now try to connect to the endpoint 
217:             # after installing App Signals. Attempts to connect will be made for up to 10 minutes
218:             if [ $deployment_failed -eq 0 ]; then
219:               . ${{ env.TEST_RESOURCES_FOLDER }}/.github/workflows/util/execute_and_retry.sh
220:               execute_and_retry 3 \
221:               "${{ env.TEST_RESOURCES_FOLDER }}/enablement-script/enable-app-signals.sh \
222:               ${{ env.CLUSTER_NAME }} \
223:               ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }} \
224:               ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }}" \
225:               "${{ env.TEST_RESOURCES_FOLDER }}/enablement-script/clean-app-signals.sh \
226:               ${{ env.CLUSTER_NAME }} \
227:               ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }} \
228:               ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }} && \
229:               aws eks update-kubeconfig --name ${{ env.CLUSTER_NAME }} --region ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}" \
230:               60
231:               
232:               aws eks update-kubeconfig --region ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }} --name ${{ env.CLUSTER_NAME }}
233: 
234:               execute_and_retry 2 "kubectl delete pods --all -n ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }}" "" 60
235:               execute_and_retry 2 "kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready --timeout=5m --request-timeout '5m' pod --all -n ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }}" "" 10
236:             fi
237: 
238:             # If the deployment_failed is 1 then either the terraform deployment or the endpoint connection failed, so first destroy the
239:             # resources created from terraform and try again.
240:             if [ $deployment_failed -eq 1 ]; then
241:               echo "Cleaning up App Signal"
242:               ${{ env.TEST_RESOURCES_FOLDER }}/enablement-script/clean-app-signals.sh \
243:               ${{ env.CLUSTER_NAME }} \
244:               ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }} \
245:               ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }}
246: 
247:               # Running clean-app-signal.sh removes the current cluster from the config. Update the cluster again for subsequent runs.
248:               aws eks update-kubeconfig --name ${{ env.CLUSTER_NAME }} --region ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}
249: 
250:               echo "Destroying terraform"
251:               terraform destroy -auto-approve \
252:                 -var="test_id=${{ env.TESTING_ID }}" \
253:                 -var="aws_region=${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}" \
254:                 -var="kube_directory_path=${{ github.workspace }}/.kube" \
255:                 -var="eks_cluster_name=${{ env.CLUSTER_NAME }}" \
256:                 -var="eks_cluster_context_name=$(kubectl config current-context)" \
257:                 -var="test_namespace=${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }}" \
258:                 -var="service_account_aws_access=service-account-${{ env.TESTING_ID }}" \
259:                 -var="dotnet_app_image=${{ env.MAIN_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE_ARN }}" \
260:                 -var="dotnet_remote_app_image=${{ env.REMOTE_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE_ARN }}"
261: 
262:               retry_counter=$(($retry_counter+1))
263:             else
264:               # If deployment succeeded, then exit the loop
265:               break
266:             fi
267: 
268:             if [ $retry_counter -ge $max_retry ]; then
269:               echo "Max retry reached, failed to deploy terraform and connect to the endpoint. Exiting code"
270:               exit 1
271:             fi
272:           done
273: 
274:       - name: Get ECR to Patch
275:         run: |
276:           if [ "${{ github.event.repository.name }}" = "amazon-cloudwatch-agent" ]; then
277:             echo PATCH_IMAGE_ARN="${{ secrets.AWS_ECR_PRIVATE_REGISTRY }}/cwagent-integration-test:${{ github.sha }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
278:           elif [ "${{ github.event.repository.name }}" = "amazon-cloudwatch-agent-operator" ]; then
279:             echo PATCH_IMAGE_ARN="${{ vars.ECR_OPERATOR_STAGING_REPO }}:${{ env.CW_AGENT_OPERATOR_TAG }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
280:           elif [ "${{ github.event.repository.name }}" = "aws-otel-dotnet-instrumentation" ]; then
281:             echo PATCH_IMAGE_ARN="${{ env.ADOT_IMAGE_NAME }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
282:           fi
283: 
284:       - name: Patch Image and Check Diff
285:         id: patch-image
286:         uses: ./.github/workflows/actions/patch_image_and_check_diff
287:         with:
288:           repository: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
289:           patch-image-arn: ${{ env.PATCH_IMAGE_ARN }}
290:           sample-app-namespace: ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }}
291: 
292:       - name: Log Artifact Versions
293:         run: |
294:           echo "ADOT Image: Previous Version is: ${{ steps.patch-image.outputs.default-adot-image }}, Updated Version is: ${{ steps.patch-image.outputs.latest-adot-image }}";
295:           echo "CW Agent Image: Previous Version is: ${{ steps.patch-image.outputs.default-cw-agent-image }}, Updated Version is: ${{ steps.patch-image.outputs.latest-cw-agent-image }}";
296:           echo "CW Agent Operator Image: Previous Version is: ${{ steps.patch-image.outputs.default-cw-agent-operator-image }}, Updated Version is: ${{ steps.patch-image.outputs.latest-cw-agent-operator-image }}";
297:           echo "Fluent Bit Image: Version is: ${{ steps.patch-image.outputs.fluent-bit-image }}";
298: 
299:       - name: Get Remote Service Deployment Name
300:         uses: ./.github/workflows/actions/execute_and_retry
301:         with:
302:           command: echo "REMOTE_SERVICE_DEPLOYMENT_NAME=$(kubectl get deployments -n ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }} --selector=app=remote-app -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')" >> $GITHUB_ENV
303:           max_retry: 3
304:           sleep_time: 30
305: 
306:       - name: Get Remote Service IP
307:         uses: ./.github/workflows/actions/execute_and_retry
308:         with:
309:           command: echo "REMOTE_SERVICE_POD_IP=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }} --selector=app=remote-app -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.podIP}')" >> $GITHUB_ENV
310:           max_retry: 3
311:           sleep_time: 30
312: 
313:       - name: Get Sample App Endpoint
314:         uses: ./.github/workflows/actions/execute_and_retry
315:         with:
316:           command: echo "APP_ENDPOINT=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }} --selector=app=dotnet-app -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.podIP}'):8080" >> $GITHUB_ENV
317:           max_retry: 3
318:           sleep_time: 30
319: 
320:       - name: Set endpoints for the traffic generator
321:         uses: ./.github/workflows/actions/execute_and_retry
322:         with:
323:           command: kubectl set env -n ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }} deployment/traffic-generator MAIN_ENDPOINT=${{ env.APP_ENDPOINT }} REMOTE_ENDPOINT=${{ env.REMOTE_SERVICE_POD_IP }}
324:           max_retry: 3
325:           sleep_time: 30
326: 
327:       - name: Initiate Gradlew Daemon
328:         if: steps.initiate-gradlew == 'failure'
329:         uses: ./.github/workflows/actions/execute_and_retry
330:         continue-on-error: true
331:         with:
332:           command: "./gradlew"
333:           cleanup: "./gradlew clean"
334:           max_retry: 3
335:           sleep_time: 60
336: 
337:       # Validation for application signals telemetry data
338:       - name: Call endpoint and validate generated EMF logs
339:         id: log-validation
340:         if: steps.deploy-dotnet-app.outcome == 'success' && !cancelled()
341:         run: ./gradlew validator:run --args='-c dotnet/eks/linux/log-validation.yml
342:           --testing-id ${{ env.TESTING_ID }}
343:           --endpoint http://${{ env.APP_ENDPOINT }}
344:           --region ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}
345:           --account-id ${{ env.ACCOUNT_ID }}
346:           --metric-namespace ${{ env.METRIC_NAMESPACE }}
347:           --log-group ${{ env.LOG_GROUP_NAME }}
348:           --app-namespace ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }}
349:           --platform-info ${{ inputs.test-cluster-name }}
350:           --service-name dotnet-application-${{ env.TESTING_ID }}
351:           --remote-service-deployment-name ${{ env.REMOTE_SERVICE_DEPLOYMENT_NAME }}
352:           --query-string ip=${{ env.REMOTE_SERVICE_POD_IP }}&testingId=${{ env.TESTING_ID }}
353:           --rollup'
354: 
355:       - name: Call endpoints and validate generated metrics
356:         id: metric-validation
357:         if: (steps.deploy-dotnet-app.outcome == 'success' || steps.log-validation.outcome == 'failure') && !cancelled()
358:         run: ./gradlew validator:run --args='-c dotnet/eks/linux/metric-validation.yml
359:           --testing-id ${{ env.TESTING_ID }}
360:           --endpoint http://${{ env.APP_ENDPOINT }}
361:           --region ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}
362:           --account-id ${{ env.ACCOUNT_ID }}

1: #!/bin/bash
2: set -ex

5: EC2_NAME=$2
6: REGION=$3
7:

9: MASTER_INSTANCE_NAME="k8s-on-ec2-${EC2_NAME}-master-${TESTING_ID}"
10: WORKER_INSTANCE_NAME="k8s-on-ec2-${EC2_NAME}-worker-${TESTING_ID}"
11: KEY_NAME="k8s-on-ec2-${EC2_NAME}-key-pair-${TESTING_ID}"
12: 
13: function create_resources() {
14:     echo "Creating Key Pair"
15:     aws ec2 create-key-pair --key-name "${KEY_NAME}" --query 'KeyMaterial' --output text > "${KEY_NAME}.pem"
16:     chmod 400  "${KEY_NAME}.pem"
17: 
18:     # Fetch the latest Amazon Linux 2 AMI ID
19:     echo "Fetching Latest Image Id"
20:     image_id=$(aws ec2 describe-images \
21:       --region $REGION \
22:       --owners amazon \
23:       --filters "Name=name,Values=al2023-ami-minimal-*-x86_64" "Name=state,Values=available" \
24:       --query 'Images | sort_by(@, &CreationDate) | [-1].ImageId' \
25:       --output text)
26: 
27:     default_vpc_id=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --filters Name=isDefault,Values=true --query 'Vpcs[0].VpcId' --output text)
28:     security_group_id=$(aws ec2 describe-security-groups --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=$default_vpc_id" "Name=group-name,Values=default" --query "SecurityGroups[0].GroupId" --output text)
29: 
30:     # Create Master EC2 Instance
31:     echo "Creating Master Instance"
32:     master_instance_id=$(aws ec2 run-instances \
33:       --image-id $image_id \
34:       --count 1 \
35:       --instance-type m5.xlarge \
36:       --key-name $KEY_NAME \
37:       --security-group-ids $security_group_id \
38:       --iam-instance-profile Name=$INSTANCE_PROFILE \
39:       --associate-public-ip-address \
40:       --block-device-mappings 'DeviceName=/dev/xvda,Ebs={VolumeSize=80,VolumeType=gp3}' \
41:       --metadata-options 'HttpPutResponseHopLimit=3,HttpEndpoint=enabled' \
42:       --query 'Instances[0].InstanceId' \
43:       --output text)
44: 
45:     aws ec2 create-tags --resources $master_instance_id --tags Key=Name,Value=$MASTER_INSTANCE_NAME Key=k8s-on-ec2-node,Value=true
46: 
47:     echo "Creating Worker Instance"
48:     worker_instance_id=$(aws ec2 run-instances \
49:       --image-id $image_id \
50:       --count 1 \
51:       --instance-type m5.xlarge \
52:       --key-name $KEY_NAME \
53:       --security-group-ids $security_group_id \
54:       --iam-instance-profile Name=$INSTANCE_PROFILE \
55:       --associate-public-ip-address \
56:       --block-device-mappings 'DeviceName=/dev/xvda,Ebs={VolumeSize=80,VolumeType=gp3}' \
57:       --metadata-options 'HttpPutResponseHopLimit=3,HttpEndpoint=enabled' \
58:       --query 'Instances[0].InstanceId' \
59:       --output text)
60: 
61:     aws ec2 create-tags --resources $worker_instance_id --tags Key=Name,Value=$WORKER_INSTANCE_NAME Key=k8s-on-ec2-node,Value=true
62: 
63:     echo "Wait for Master Instance $master_instance_id and Worker Instance $worker_instance_id to be ready"
64:     aws ec2 wait instance-status-ok --instance-ids $master_instance_id
65:     aws ec2 wait instance-status-ok --instance-ids $worker_instance_id
66:     echo "All instances are up and running."
67: }
68: 
69: 
70: function run_k8s_master() {
71:   # Retrieve public IP of k8s master node
72:   master_ip=$(aws ec2 describe-instances \
73:       --filters "Name=tag:Name,Values=$MASTER_INSTANCE_NAME" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" \
74:       --query "Reservations[*].Instances[*].PublicIpAddress" \
75:       --output text)
76: 
77:   # SSH and run commands on the master node
78:   master_private_ip=$(aws ec2 describe-instances \
79:       --filters "Name=tag:Name,Values=$MASTER_INSTANCE_NAME" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" \
80:       --query "Reservations[*].Instances[*].PrivateIpAddress" \
81:       --output text)
82: 
83:   worker_private_ip=$(aws ec2 describe-instances \
84:       --filters "Name=tag:Name,Values=$WORKER_INSTANCE_NAME" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" \
85:       --query "Reservations[*].Instances[*].PrivateIpAddress" \
86:       --output text)
87: 
88:   # set up kubeadmin
89:   ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -i "${KEY_NAME}.pem" ec2-user@$master_ip << EOF
90:     sudo yum update -y && sudo yum install -y https://s3.amazonaws.com/ec2-downloads-windows/SSMAgent/latest/linux_amd64/amazon-ssm-agent.rpm
91:     sudo yum install docker tmux git vim -y && sudo usermod -aG docker ec2-user
92:     sudo systemctl enable docker && sudo systemctl start docker
93:     sudo containerd config default > config.toml
94:     sudo cp config.toml /etc/containerd/config.toml
95:     sudo sed -i 's/SystemdCgroup \= false/SystemdCgroup \= true/' /etc/containerd/config.toml
96:     sudo sed -i 's/systemd_cgroup \= true/systemd_cgroup \= true/' /etc/containerd/config.toml
97:     sudo systemctl restart containerd && sleep 20
98:     sudo setenforce 0 && sudo sed -i 's/^SELINUX=enforcing$/SELINUX=permissive/' /etc/selinux/config
99:     echo -e "[kubernetes]\nname=Kubernetes\nbaseurl=https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.29/rpm/\nenabled=1\ngpgcheck=1\ngpgkey=https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.29/rpm/repodata/repomd.xml.key\nexclude=kubelet kubeadm kubectl cri-tools kubernetes-cni" | sudo tee /etc/yum.repos.d/kubernetes.repo
100:     sudo yum install -y kubelet kubeadm kubectl --disableexcludes=kubernetes
101:     sudo systemctl enable --now kubelet && sudo systemctl restart kubelet && sleep 30
102:     sudo kubeadm init --pod-network-cidr=192.168.0.0/16 --apiserver-advertise-address=$master_private_ip --apiserver-cert-extra-sans=$worker_private_ip
103:     mkdir -p \$HOME/.kube
104:     sudo cp -i /etc/kubernetes/admin.conf \$HOME/.kube/config
105:     sudo chown \$(id -u):\$(id -g) \$HOME/.kube/config
106:     sleep 120
107:     curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/projectcalico/calico/v3.27.2/manifests/calico.yaml -O
108:     kubectl apply -f calico.yaml && sleep 60
109:     sudo cd \$HOME
110:     sudo cp /etc/kubernetes/pki/apiserver.crt apiserver.crt
111:     sudo cp /etc/kubernetes/pki/apiserver.key apiserver.key
112:     sudo chmod +r apiserver.key
113:     sudo kubeadm token create --print-join-command > join-cluster.sh
114:     sudo chmod +x join-cluster.sh
115:     echo "tlsCertFile: /etc/kubernetes/pki/apiserver.crt" | sudo tee -a /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml
116:     echo "tlsPrivateKeyFile: /etc/kubernetes/pki/apiserver.key" | sudo tee -a /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml
117:     sudo systemctl restart kubelet
118: EOF
119: 
120:   scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -i "${KEY_NAME}.pem" ec2-user@$master_ip:~/apiserver.crt . 
121:   scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -i "${KEY_NAME}.pem" ec2-user@$master_ip:~/apiserver.key . 
122:   scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -i "${KEY_NAME}.pem" ec2-user@$master_ip:~/join-cluster.sh . 
123: 
124: }

## Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. All Rights Reserved.
## SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

# This is a reusable workflow for running the Enablement test for Application Signals
# on Windows nodes in an EKS cluster.
# It is meant to be called from another workflow.
# Read more about reusable workflows: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/reusing-workflows#overview
name: DotNet EKS Windows Use Case
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      aws-region:
        required: true
        type: string
      test-cluster-name:
        required: true
        type: string
      adot-image-name:
        required: false
        type: string
      cw-agent-operator-tag:
        required: false
        type: string
      caller-workflow-name:
        required: true
        type: string
    outputs:
      job-started:
        value: ${{ jobs.dotnet-eks-windows.outputs.job-started }}
      validation-result:
        value: ${{ jobs.dotnet-eks-windows.outputs.validation-result }}

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

env:
  E2E_TEST_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLICATION_SIGNALS_E2E_TEST_ACCOUNT_ID }}
  E2E_TEST_ROLE_NAME: ${{ secrets.APPLICATION_SIGNALS_E2E_TEST_ROLE_NAME }}
  E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION: ${{ inputs.aws-region }}
  CLUSTER_NAME: ${{ inputs.test-cluster-name }}
  METRIC_NAMESPACE: ApplicationSignals
  LOG_GROUP_NAME: /aws/application-signals/data
  TEST_RESOURCES_FOLDER: ${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}
  ADOT_IMAGE_NAME: ${{ inputs.adot-image-name }}
  CW_AGENT_OPERATOR_TAG: ${{ inputs.cw-agent-operator-tag }}

jobs:
  # Windows sample app images are built and pushed to ECR before they can be
  # deployed onto the Windows node group of the EKS cluster.
  build-windows-images:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: 'aws-observability/aws-application-signals-test-framework'
          ref: ${{ inputs.caller-workflow-name == 'main-build' && 'main' || github.ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Generate testing id
        run: |
          echo TESTING_ID="${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_number }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Configure AWS Credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::${{ env.E2E_TEST_ACCOUNT_ID }}:role/${{ env.E2E_TEST_ROLE_NAME }}
          aws-region: us-east-1

      - name: Retrieve account
        uses: aws-actions/aws-secretsmanager-get-secrets@v1
        with:
          secret-ids: |
            ACCOUNT_ID, region-account/${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}
            DOTNET_MAIN_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE, e2e-test/dotnet-main-sample-app-image-windows
            DOTNET_REMOTE_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE, e2e-test/dotnet-remote-sample-app-image-windows

      - name: Configure AWS Credentials

          retry_counter=0

              "${{ env.TEST_RESOURCES_FOLDER }}/enablement-script/enable-app-signals.sh \
              ${{ env.CLUSTER_NAME }} \
              ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }} \
              ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }}" \
              "${{ env.TEST_RESOURCES_FOLDER }}/enablement-script/clean-app-signals.sh \
              ${{ env.CLUSTER_NAME }} \
              ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }} \
              ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }} && \

              execute_and_retry 2 "kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready --timeout=5m --request-timeout '5m' pod --all -n ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }}" "" 10
            fi

            # If the deployment_failed is 1 then either the terraform deployment or the endpoint connection failed, so first destroy the

                -var="aws_region=${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}" \

                -var="dotnet_remote_app_image=${{ env.REMOTE_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE_ARN }}"

              retry_counter=$(($retry_counter+1))
            else

          --query-string ip=${{ env.REMOTE_SERVICE_POD_IP }}&testingId=${{ env.TESTING_ID }}

        if: (steps.deploy-dotnet-app.outcome == 'success' || steps.log-validation.outcome == 'failure' || steps.metric-validation.outcome == 'failure') && !cancelled()

          --region ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}

          --query-string ip=${{ env.REMOTE_SERVICE_POD_IP }}&testingId=${{ env.TESTING_ID }}

      - name: Save test results
        if: always()
        id: validation-result
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.log-validation.outcome }}" = "success" ] && [ "${{ steps.metric-validation.outcome }}" = "success" ] && [ "${{ steps.trace-validation.outcome }}" = "success" ]; then

      - name: Delete all sample app resources

        working-directory: terraform/dotnet/eks/windows
        run: |
          terraform destroy -auto-approve \
            -var="test_id=${{ env.TESTING_ID }}" \

            -var="test_namespace=${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }}" \
            -var="service_account_aws_access=service-account-${{ env.TESTING_ID }}" \
            -var="dotnet_app_image=${{ env.MAIN_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE_ARN }}" \
            -var="dotnet_remote_app_image=${{ env.REMOTE_SAMPLE_APP_IMAGE_ARN }}"

      - name: Remove aws access service account
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          eksctl delete iamserviceaccount \
          --name service-account-${{ env.TESTING_ID }} \
          --namespace ${{ env.DOTNET_SAMPLE_APP_NAMESPACE }} \
          --cluster ${{ inputs.test-cluster-name }} \
          --region ${{ env.E2E_TEST_AWS_REGION }}

## Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. All Rights Reserved.
## SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

## This workflow aims to run the Application Signals DotNet end-to-end tests on Windows EKS nodes as a canary to
## test the artifacts for Application Signals enablement. It will deploy the sample app and remote
## service as Windows containers onto an EKS cluster with a Windows node group, call the APIs, and validate
## the generated telemetry, including logs, metrics, and traces.
name: Dotnet EKS Windows Enablement Canary Testing
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 * * * *' # run the workflow every hour
  workflow_dispatch: # be able to run the workflow on demand

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  eks:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        aws-region: ['af-south-1','ap-east-1','ap-northeast-1','ap-northeast-2','ap-northeast-3','ap-south-1','ap-south-2','ap-southeast-1',
                     'ap-southeast-2','ap-southeast-3','ap-southeast-4','ca-central-1','eu-central-1','eu-central-2','eu-north-1',
                     'eu-south-1','eu-south-2','eu-west-1','eu-west-2','eu-west-3','il-central-1','me-central-1','me-south-1', 'sa-east-1',
                     'us-east-1','us-east-2', 'us-west-1', 'us-west-2']
    uses: ./.github/workflows/dotnet-eks-windows-test.yml
    secrets: inherit
    with:
      aws-region: ${{ matrix.aws-region }}
      test-cluster-name: 'e2e-dotnet-canary-windows-test'
